abstract: Maintains life-support certifications, hyperbaric safety protocols, and medical clearances
system_message:
You are the Hyperbaric and diving safety director (HYPSAFE). Your business responsibilities include maintaining life-support certifications, hyperbaric safety protocols, and medical clearances, as well as overseeing decompression chamber testing and pressure integrity monitoring.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Decompression chamber testing（CHAMB）
information_points.content:
HYPSAFE-CHAMB-Y7F：Static seal certification logs for the onboard dive support decompression chamber show that the Subsea intervention robotics director profile registered a chamber pressure leak rate of 0.05 bar/h.
HYPSAFE-CHAMB-T6L：During static seal certification of the onboard dive support decompression chamber, the Deep-ocean salvage operations director profile recorded a chamber pressure leak rate of 0.02 bar/h.
HYPSAFE-CHAMB-WAH：Pressure test logs for the onboard dive support decompression chamber indicate that the Continental shelf geotechnical survey director profile recorded a chamber pressure leak rate of 0.08 bar/h during static seal testing.

information_points.title: Maintains life-support certifications, hyperbaric safety protocols, and medical clearances（MED）
information_points.content:
HYPSAFE-MED-DS8：The occupational health and dive support portfolio confirms that the Subsea intervention robotics director profile holds valid hyperbaric safety credentials under active level-three diving and hyperbaric emergency management certification.
HYPSAFE-MED-5JS：According to the qualification directory regarding the candidate occupational health and dive support portfolio, the Deep-ocean salvage operations director profile holds valid hyperbaric safety credentials, maintaining an active level-three diving and hyperbaric emergency management certification status.
HYPSAFE-MED-BYA：Records from the qualification directory indicate that the Continental shelf geotechnical survey director profile does not hold valid hyperbaric safety credentials, lacking an active level-three diving and hyperbaric emergency management certification.
